title: Refine Design UX Review Receipt 0.2
description: Closed machine contract for an independent qualitative review of exact product-description and persisted UX content over a bounded scope.
x-semanticRules: subject.productDescription.id must identify the current human-owned product-description source listed by the UX artifact, and its sha256 must match the exact authoritative product-description bytes supplied to validation.
subject.uxArtifact id and revision must exactly match the validated persisted UX artifact, and its sha256 must match the exact authoritative UX bytes supplied to validation.
subject.scopeRefs must be a nonempty unique set that exactly matches the parent-requested scope, independent of order, and every reference must exist in the UX artifact.
coverage must contain exactly one row for each of the ten canonical criteria.
Every coverage evidenceRef and finding recordRef must reference an existing record in the UX artifact.
Every coverage row whose result is finding must be covered by at least one blocking finding whose criteria array includes that row's criterion.
Every criterion named by a blocking finding must have a coverage row whose result is finding.
Finding identifiers must be unique; every finding criteria array must be nonempty and contain unique canonical criteria.
researchChecks must contain exactly one row for every patternResearch record relevant to the expanded requested scope and no unrelated rows.
Every researchCheck sourceRef must identify a source inside its referenced patternResearch record.
A blocking finding, a finding coverage result, or an unsupported or unverified research check requires verdict revise.
A pass verdict may contain advisory findings only and does not claim usability validation, accessibility conformance, engineering feasibility, standards compliance, or implementation approval.
No field outside this schema is permitted; qualitative conclusions remain the reviewer's responsibility rather than an implication of structural validity.
